(#{it.kbId}, #{it.fileId}, #{it.fileName}, #{it.fileSize}, #{it.filePath}, #{it.fullTextPath}, #{it.status},#{it.createBy},#{it.gmtCreate},#{it.modifyBy},#{it.gmtModified},#{it.parsedFilePath}, #{it.parseType},#{it.faqExtractStatus},#{it.reviseDate},#{it.parentFileName},#{it.version},#{it.convertedFilePath}, #{it.folderId},#{it.sourceUrl},#{it.uid},#{it.tempStatus},#{it.chunking},#{it.groupId},#{it.chunkType})

SELECT any_value(id) id, any_value(kb_id) kb_id, any_value(file_name) file_name, parent_file_name, any_value (version) version FROM ( SELECT id, kb_id, parent_file_name, file_name, version,REPLACE(version,"V","") v FROM knowledge_base_list WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} and status!=0
and parse_type in
(1,10)
(2,10)
(3)
(4)
and parse_type in (1,2,10)
ORDER BY v DESC limit 10000 ) kbl GROUP BY kbl.parent_file_name

mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS (SELECT id, parent_id FROM department_info WHERE id = #{deptId}
UNION ALL
SELECT d.id, d.parent_id FROM department_info d JOIN dept_tree dt ON d.id = dt.parent_id), all_permissions AS (SELECT target_id, permission, biz_type FROM dept_privilege
is_del = 1 AND dept_id = #{deptId} AND permission > 0
UNION
SELECT gp.target_id, gp.permission, gp.biz_type FROM group_privilege gp JOIN user_group ug ON gp.group_id = ug.group_id WHERE gp.is_del = 1 AND ug.user_id = #{userId} AND gp.permission > 0
UNION
SELECT gp.target_id, gp.permission, gp.biz_type FROM group_privilege gp JOIN user_group ug ON gp.group_id = ug.group_id JOIN dept_tree dt ON dt.id = ug.dept_id WHERE gp.is_del = 1 AND gp.permission > 0
UNION
SELECT target_id, permission, biz_type FROM user_privilege WHERE is_del = 1 AND user_id = #{userId} AND permission > 0 UNION
SELECT target_id, permission, biz_type FROM user_privilege WHERE is_del = 1 AND user_id = -1 AND permission > 0 ) , max_permissions AS (SELECT target_id, biz_type, MAX(permission) AS permission FROM all_permissions
AND biz_type in
#{bizType}
GROUP BY target_id, biz_type) SELECT kb.id, kb.kb_id, kb.file_name, kb.folder_id, NULL AS folder_name, 0 AS is_folder, mp.permission FROM max_permissions mp JOIN knowledge_base_list kb ON mp.target_id = kb.id WHERE
mp.biz_type = 4 AND
kb.kb_id = #{kbId} AND kb.parse_type = #{parseType} AND kb.status > 0
UNION
SELECT NULL AS id, f.kb_id, NULL AS file_name, f.id AS folder_id, f.name AS folder_name, 1 AS is_folder, mp.permission FROM max_permissions mp JOIN folder_info f ON mp.target_id = f.id WHERE
mp.biz_type = 6 AND
f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.type = #{folderType} AND f.status = 1

select t3.*, t2.permission from (SELECT target_id, MAX(permission) as permission FROM (
SELECT dept_privilege.target_id, permission FROM dept_privilege WHERE is_del =1 AND dept_id = #{deptId} AND biz_type = 4 AND permission =0 UNION
SELECT gp.target_id, permission FROM group_privilege gp LEFT JOIN user_group ug ON gp.group_id = ug.group_id WHERE gp.is_del = 1 AND ug.user_id = #{userId} AND biz_type = 4 AND permission = 0 UNION
UNION SELECT user_privilege.target_id, permission FROM user_privilege WHERE is_del = 1 AND user_id = #{userId} AND biz_type = 4 AND permission = 0) t1 GROUP BY target_id) t2 left join knowledge_base_list t3 on t2.target_id = t3.id
